youtube_description:
The historic Victorian ice wells beneath the London Canal Museum will become home to a new subterranean physics-inspired installation commissioned by the Institute of Physics by artist Lyndall Phelps. Over the last 6 months she has been working with physicist Ben Still, exploring each other's research, mindset and culture. The result is a unique and thought provoking artwork that illustrates the power of cross-disciplinary collaboration.

You can read the blog at www.physics.org/superposition.
youtube_title: Superposition: collaboration between artists and physicists
